title: [E-Document] Set max output tokens for MLLM extraction (29.x)
summary: The E-Document MLLM Handler now sets an explicit maximum output token budget for MLLM extraction during e-document import, in preparation for the 5.6 model. This is a backport to 29.x.
key_points: Explicit max output tokens set for MLLM extraction in codeunit 6231
quote: Set explicit ouput token budget to prepare for 5.6 model.
